title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Exposure Standard — One Credit Relationship per Business and Cross-Default
content:
The two Ridgeline Pro Credit accounts of one business are managed as one credit relationship.

## Relationship exposure cap

The sum of the credit lines over the business's accounts whose status is active or on hold may not exceed **1250000.00 USD**, the relationship exposure cap.

An approval or a credit line increase that would exceed the cap is reduced to the headroom — the cap less the sum of the credit lines of the business's other accounts whose status is active or on hold, the account being decided excluded — rounded down to the tier's credit line rounding increment. It is not granted when the reduced line is below the tier's lowest credit line.

| Step of the test | What is read |
|---|---|
| Other open lines | Credit lines of every other Ridgeline Pro Credit account of the business in active or on-hold status, at the moment of the decision |
| Headroom | 1250000.00 less the other open lines |
| Reduced line | The headroom rounded down to the tier's rounding increment |
| Not granted | When the reduced line is below the tier's lowest credit line |

Hypothetical example: a business holds an active Pro Revolving Charge Plus with a line of 24500.00 and a Commercial Account Net 60 Enterprise line is being decided. The headroom is 1250000.00 less 24500.00, that is 1225500.00; a line at or below 1225500.00 is not reduced by the cap, and the account being decided never counts among the other open lines.

## Cross-default between the two accounts

- When either account of the business is placed on hold for delinquency or over-limit, its other active account is placed on hold the same day, with the hold reason "sister account hold".
- An account on hold for sister account hold is released the same day the sister account is released, and is never released while the sister account remains on hold.

Hypothetical example: a Pro Revolving Charge goes on hold for past-due on a given day; the business's active Commercial Account Net 30 goes on hold that same day for sister account hold, and stays on hold until the day the Pro Revolving Charge is released.
